messages.message: WHY does this meme describe your workday so perfectly 😂
I don't appreciate being observed this accurately.
You literally said 'one quick fix' and disappeared for two hours.
It was not a quick fix. The layout had other plans.
The caption says the same thing happened to the creator.
Send me the original post, I need to share it.
Sent. Check the message requests too if it doesn't show.
Found it. This is going on my story.
Please add no context. Let people wonder.
You're enjoying this too much.
A little bit, yes 😂

conversations.last_message: A little bit, yes 😂

messages.message: Did you keep the receipt from the print shop?
I think it's in the side pocket of my bag.
Could you check when you get home? I need the order number.
Sure. Is something wrong with the prints?
Two copies arrived with a line across the bottom.
Oh no. Was the packaging damaged?
The envelope looked fine, so it may be a printing issue.
Take a photo of the affected copies before contacting them.
Already did that. I'll attach it to the email.
I'll look for the receipt and send you the number.
Thanks, that should make the replacement easier.

conversations.last_message: Thanks, that should make the replacement easier.

messages.message: I started the book you recommended last week.
Finally! How far have you got?
About four chapters in. The pacing is better than I expected.
The middle is where it really gets interesting.
I'm trying not to look up any reviews or spoilers.
Good plan. The less you know, the better.
I need something to read on the commute now.
That one is perfect because the chapters are short.
I'll let you know when I finish it.
Then I'll send you the next one on my list.
Deal, but give me a day to recover first 😂

conversations.last_message: Deal, but give me a day to recover first 😂

messages.message: Did the tips in that carousel help with your photos?
Yes, especially the bit about locking exposure.
It makes such a difference in bright places.
I tested it outside this afternoon and the shots look more consistent.
Did you edit them afterwards?
Just a little contrast and crop, nothing heavy.
That sounds like a good workflow.
I'm trying to get it right in camera first.
Send me the best one when you post it.
Will do. I still need to pick a cover image.
Choose the one that makes you stop scrolling.

conversations.last_message: Choose the one that makes you stop scrolling.

messages.message: Can we please choose a date for the catch-up?
I'm free Friday after work.
Friday is difficult for me, Saturday afternoon is better.
Saturday works if we finish before evening.
Looks like Saturday is winning so far.
Where are we thinking? Somewhere easy to reach.
There is a new spot near the station I want to try.
Send the page so we can check the menu.
Just posted it above.
The menu looks reasonable. I'm happy with that.
I'll confirm after I check one family thing.
Let's settle it by Thursday so nobody double-books.

conversations.last_message: Let's settle it by Thursday so nobody double-books.

messages.message: How did the presentation go this morning?
Better than I expected! They asked me to explain the last section.
That's a good sign. Were you prepared for questions?
I practised those with my sister last night.
She kept asking the hardest possible questions 😂
Sounds like she accidentally became your best coach.
Honestly, yes. I didn't freeze when they asked.
I'm proud of you for getting through it.
Thank you. I can finally stop thinking about every slide.
Please take the evening off now.
That's the plan. Food first, absolutely no laptop.
Excellent decision.

conversations.last_message: Excellent decision.

messages.message: Can I ask you something about the application process?
Of course, what's up?
Do you think I should include the personal project even though it's unfinished?
If it shows a useful skill, include it and label it as a work in progress.
I was worried that might look unprofessional.
Not if you explain what works and what you're still improving.
That makes sense. I'll add a short note under it.
Keep the note specific rather than apologising for it.
Good point. Can I send you the page to review later?
Sure, send it when the first draft is ready.
Thanks, I needed a second opinion.

conversations.last_message: Thanks, I needed a second opinion.

messages.message: I changed outfits three times before leaving the house.
The final one looked effortless in your story 😂
That is the result of forty minutes of chaos.
The colour combination was really good though.
Thank you! I nearly wore the plain black top instead.
I'm glad you didn't. The jacket made it.
I'm keeping that outfit saved for another day.
We should plan something where we can dress up a little.
Dinner next weekend? Somewhere with good lighting.
I'm in. Saturday or Sunday?
Saturday is better. I'll send a few ideas.

conversations.last_message: Saturday is better. I'll send a few ideas.

messages.message: I found a tutorial that explains the animation properly.
Is it the one with the blue cover image?
Yes, that one. The author includes the source files.
That saves me a lot of guessing.
The key is to animate the wrapper, not every child.
Ah, that explains why my version was jumping.
Try it on a small component first.
Then add the easing once the layout behaves.
I'll test it after lunch.
I bookmarked the docs too in case the video skips a step.
Send me those docs when you get a second.
Just dropped the link in this chat.

conversations.last_message: Just dropped the link in this chat.

messages.message: Do you know where this café is? I saw it in your story.
It's tucked behind the flower shop on Allen Avenue.
Would never have guessed from the outside.
The entrance is tiny, but the courtyard is lovely.
Their iced coffee is good too.
Is it quiet enough to work for an hour?
In the morning, yes. It gets louder after lunch.
That's exactly what I need. Thanks!
Try the table near the back wall.
I'll go there this week and report back.
Please do, I want to know what you think of the pastries.
Now you've convinced me 😂

conversations.last_message: Now you've convinced me 😂

messages.message: I put the photos from yesterday in the shared album.
The last one is my favourite, the timing is perfect.
Please send the unedited version too.
I can send it after I finish sorting the folder.
No pressure, the ones you posted already look great.
That café was a good find by the way.
We should go back when the outdoor seats are open.
And actually arrive before the sun goes down this time 😭
I can do next Sunday if everyone is free.
Let’s check our calendars first.
I saved the place so I wouldn't lose it.

conversations.last_message: I saved the place so I wouldn't lose it.

messages.message: The jacket you posted looks lovely. Where did you find it?
A small store I found through a creator's page.
Was the sizing accurate?
Mostly, but the sleeves are a little long on me.
The fabric feels better than I expected.
Could you send the store handle?
Just shared it. Check the message above.
Found it, thank you!
Look through the highlights for the size chart.
I will. I'm trying not to order things without checking measurements.
That is the responsible approach 😂
I'll tell you if I end up getting it.

conversations.last_message: I'll tell you if I end up getting it.

messages.message: Have you listened to the new album all the way through?
Twice already. The production is ridiculous.
Track four caught me off guard in a good way.
That bass line comes in so smoothly.
Track seven is my other favourite.
I'll listen again with headphones tonight.
Do that, there are little background details everywhere.
Any songs you'd skip on the first listen?
Honestly, play it in order the first time.
Alright, album night it is.
Send me your ranking after you've heard it.
You know I'm going to overthink the ranking 😂

conversations.last_message: You know I'm going to overthink the ranking 😂

messages.message: I tried a different layout for today's post.
I saw it! The spacing looks much better.
I was worried the text would feel too small.
It's readable, and the first slide has a clear focus.
That is what I was aiming for.
I removed two lines from the original caption.
Good call. The shorter version gets to the point.
I'm learning to stop explaining every detail 😂
The details can go in the next slide if people need them.
True. I'll keep that in mind for the next one.
Send me the template if you're happy with it.
Sure, I'll export a clean copy this evening.

conversations.last_message: Sure, I'll export a clean copy this evening.

messages.message: Can you remind me what time the workshop starts?
Registration opens at 9:30, first session is at ten.
Great, I thought it was ten-thirty.
Did they send the venue details too?
It's in the confirmation email. I'll forward the address.
Got it, thank you.
Are you taking your laptop or just a notebook?
Laptop. They said there'll be a practical session.
Good idea. Charge it tonight.
Already plugged it in 😂
Look at this meme before you go back to work.
That caption is too accurate, I'm crying 😭

conversations.last_message: That caption is too accurate, I'm crying 😭

messages.message: That story from last night was painfully accurate 😭
I posted it and immediately thought of this group.
The part about everyone saying 'five minutes' got me.
Because none of us has ever been ready in five minutes.
I was ready on time once in 2022.
We need proof. Nobody believes that claim.
Let's settle it with an actual plan this weekend.
Saturday evening? I can make that work.
After six is easiest for me.
Pick somewhere near a bus stop please.
I'll share two options tonight and we can vote.

conversations.last_message: I'll share two options tonight and we can vote.

messages.message: Found that little restaurant I mentioned.
Their page has the menu in the highlights.
The food looks good. Have you actually been there?
Went with my cousin last week.
The rice bowl was worth the trip.
How busy was it around lunch?
Pretty full by one, but the queue moved quickly.
Maybe we should go earlier then.
I can do twelve-thirty on Friday.
Friday works. I'll check my schedule after this call.
No rush, just let me know by Thursday.
Deal. Send me the location so I don't wander past it.
Just sent the map link to your DMs.

conversations.last_message: Just sent the map link to your DMs.

messages.message: We have been saying we'll catch up for weeks.
I know, our calendars keep missing each other.
What about a short call one evening this week?
Thursday after seven should work.
That works. I'll keep it free.
Anything you want to talk about in particular?
Nothing urgent, just a proper catch-up.
I have a few updates, though.
Now I'm curious. Save them for Thursday.
No spoilers then 😂
I'll message you when I'm back home.
Perfect. Let's actually make it happen this time.

conversations.last_message: Perfect. Let's actually make it happen this time.

messages.message: Are we still doing the little photo walk this weekend?
Yes! Saturday afternoon is still good for me.
Perfect, I checked the weather and it looks clear.
We should start around three so the light is nice.
Works for me. Any area in mind?
Maybe around the old bookshops and the side streets.
Good shout. There are colourful doors around there too.
Bring your small camera if you have it.
I will. I need to clear the memory card first 😂
Please do that before we meet this time
I am not waiting while you delete photos again 😭
Fair enough, message received.
I'll send a pin on Saturday morning.

conversations.last_message: I'll send a pin on Saturday morning.

messages.message: The package finally arrived this morning!
Nice! Was everything in good condition?
Yes, all the pieces were wrapped separately.
How does the colour look in person?
A little warmer than the website photo, but I like it.
That usually looks better in daylight anyway.
I'll take a proper photo when I get home.
Tag me if you post it, I want to see the full set.
Of course. I need to clear a spot on the shelf first.
The fun part is finding a place for everything 😂
Exactly. I'll send you a picture once it's arranged.

conversations.last_message: Exactly. I'll send you a picture once it's arranged.

messages.message: Your latest carousel came out really well.
Thanks! I spent way too long choosing the cover photo.
Which slide did you like best?
The one with the window light. It feels natural.
That was the last photo I took
Nearly left it out too.
Glad you kept it. The caption works with it.
I tried to make it less formal this time.
It reads more like you talking to a friend.
That was the idea exactly.
Did you save that post I shared?
Yep, I bookmarked it. I want to try that layout.
Send me yours when you do, I want to see it.

conversations.last_message: Send me yours when you do, I want to see it.

messages.message: I posted the updated design just now.
Saw it. The new typeface suits the layout better.
I tried three options before settling on this one.
The old one felt a little too condensed.
Exactly what I thought, but I couldn't explain it.
The letters have more room to breathe now.
I'm going to reuse the style for the next page.
Just make sure the heading scale stays consistent.
I'll make a type scale in the file first.
That'll save you from tweaking every heading manually.
Appreciate the feedback. I'll share the file later.

conversations.last_message: Appreciate the feedback. I'll share the file later.

messages.message: Quick update: the place I suggested is closed on Sundays.
Good thing we checked before deciding.
Could do Saturday instead if the rest of you are free.
Saturday afternoon works for me.
I'll check whether they take walk-ins.
I found another place two streets away too.
Send both links and we can compare.
Please make sure one has outdoor seating.
Added that to the requirements 😂
I sent the second option. The menu looks good.
Let's vote tonight so we can stop planning in circles.

conversations.last_message: Let's vote tonight so we can stop planning in circles.

messages.message: Did you get a chance to look at the reel I sent?
The editing transition at the end is so clean.
I watched it on the bus this morning
I actually replayed that last bit twice 😂
Right? The timing makes the whole thing work.
I saved it for reference
Could try something similar for my portfolio video.
That would suit your project really well.
Keep the colours a little warmer though.
Noted. I was testing a cooler grade yesterday.
Send me a draft when you have one.
Deal
I have to finish the title cards first.
How far along are you with those?
Almost done now
I finally finished the project!

conversations.last_message: I finally finished the project!
